menorquianas.intro: From Kentucky to Menorca. A new chapter begins here: I'm coordinating a reading-comprehension programme run by the Balearic Islands at my school, and I'll keep writing it all down just like always. To the old commenters of the Kentukiana Chronicles: this isn't a goodbye, it's a «see you in the next one». Welcome to the Menorquianas.
